# gitmoap_group_milestone (Resource)

Creates an open milestone in the group, with a title and an optional description and due date. Only the group's own work items can be put into it. Maintainers and above may create milestones, up to the group's milestone limit.

The token needs `milestone:manage` and `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitmoap_group_milestone" "launch" {
  group_id    = gitmoap_group.platform.group_id
  title       = "Public launch"
  description = "Everything that has to land before launch"
  due_on      = "2027-03-31"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `description` (String)
- `due_on` (String) A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time and no zone — a due date, or the day an iteration starts or ends.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Number)
- `closed` (Boolean)
- `completed` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `milestone_id` (String) Milestone ID
- `open` (Number)
- `points_completed` (Number)
- `points_total` (Number)
- `scope_id` (String)
- `scope_type` (String)
- `total` (Number)
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `issue_ref` (Attributes) Names a work item from outside its own repository or group, since a number like `#412` only identifies an issue within one of them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--issue_ref))
- `issue_uid` (String)
- `linked_at` (String)
- `milestone_id` (String)
- `points` (Number)
- `status_category` (String) The fixed category behind a status. A status also has a *name*, which the team owns and may
rename freely; the category is the part the platform reasons about. A team can call a status
"Ready for QA" and the platform still knows it is `in_review` — so a board can place it in a
column, a merge can move it, and a progress rollup can count it as not done.
- `work_item_type` (String) The kind of work item. The type decides where an item may live (a group or a repository), which
types it may have as children, and which fields it accepts.

<a id="nestedatt--items--issue_ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.issue_ref`

Read-Only:

- `iid` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by its group_id and milestone_id, joined with slashes.
terraform import gitmoap_group_milestone.example "<group_id>/<milestone_id>"
```
